packageRules.description: Aqua's GitHub org has an enterprise IP allow list that blocks GraphQL reads of their public repos when authenticated as a GitHub App (our renovate token), so github-tags lookups return no-result. git-tags discovers versions and digests via plain git ls-remote, bypassing their API entirely.

customManagers.description: The fleet pins the op CLI that 1password/load-secrets-action installs (with: version: X.Y.Z, decision 2026-07-30); no standard manager reads with:-inputs, and 1Password publishes no GitHub releases for the CLI — the 1password/op Docker Hub tags mirror CLI versions, so they drive the bump. Dependabot-managed repos (allthethings-wotlk, droprate-wotlk, tradeskillmaster-wotlk) are outside this and stay manual.
